voice: Country accent (y'all, reckon, fixin' to, sugar, darlin', dropped g's), warm to the point of madness: relentlessly optimistic, deeply empathic, sorry for everyone, sees the good in the enemy.

greeting: Well howdy there, friend! Ain't it just a beautiful day for a brand new friendship?
Hi, sugar! I just know we're gonna get along like biscuits and gravy!
Mornin', y'all! Yep, even if it's midnight, it's mornin' somewhere!
Aw, look at you! Come here, you look like you could use a hug!
Hey now! Don't you worry about a thing, I got a real good feelin' about today!
battle_start: Alright, y'all, let's go make some friends! Fast ones, with tanks!
Ain't nobody gonna get hurt who don't want to! Okay, maybe a little. Bless 'em.
Saddle up! We're fixin' to turn this whole day around!
I reckon if we all just try our very best, it'll turn out wonderful!
Giddy up, darlin's! Today's gonna be the best day of our lives!
attack: Sorry, honey! Hope that didn't smart too much!
Yeehaw! That one's from the heart!
Aw, shucks, did I do that? I sure am sorry, sweetheart!
Bullseye! You're gonna feel better tomorrow, I promise!
Y'all just hold still, this'll be over before ya know it!
unit_lost: Oh no, not Biscuit! He was a real good tank. Bless his little treads.
Aw, that's okay! He's in a better place now. A warm place with snacks!
Well, that stings. But hey, now we get to build a shiny new one!
Don't you fret, sweet pea. He knew we loved him.
I'll write his mama a real nice letter. Right after we win!
capture: Well lookie here, a whole new building! I'll bake y'all a pie!
This is ours now! Let's put up some curtains and make it homey!
Neighbors! I can't wait to meet y'all!
Aw, ain't it sweet? We'll take real good care of it!
Y'all, we just got ourselves a new porch! Who wants lemonade?
danger: Okay, okay, that's a little scary. But we're gonna be just fine, I promise!
Hold on tight, y'all! Every storm runs out of rain!
Dagnabbit! Well, nothin' a good cry and a hug won't fix. After we win.
They're awful close. But I'm sure they've just got a lonely heart!
Stay strong, darlin's! I believe in every last one of ya!
victory: We did it, y'all! Group hug! Everybody! Even you, enemies!
Wooo-ee! I knew it all along! I just knew it!
What a glorious day! I'm gonna cry. Don't mind me, I'm just happy!
Ain't nothin' sweeter than a win shared with friends!
Told ya it'd work out! It always does! Mostly!
defeat: Well, shoot. That didn't go like I hoped. But tomorrow's another day!
It's alright, y'all! We learned somethin' real valuable! I forget what!
Don't you be sad now, it just means the next win's gonna be even sweeter!
That's okay! We'll get 'em next time, and I'll bring cookies!
Aw, they were just havin' a good day. Good for them!
taunt: Hey now, sugar, you look awful upset. Wanna talk about it?
Y'all don't gotta fight! But if you're gonna, I'll be real sweet about it!
Honey, you're gonna feel so much better when you lose!
I ain't mad at ya! I just reckon you're on the wrong team!
Bless your heart, you tried so hard! That's what counts!
praise: Well, aren't you just the best thing since sliced bread!
Oh my stars, you're a natural! I'm so proud of ya!
Look at you go! I'm gonna tell everybody!
That was beautiful, darlin'! I got a tear in my eye!
You're doin' great, sweetie! Absolutely marvelous!
idle: Y'know, I reckon every day's a gift. Even the ones with explosions!
I wonder if the enemy tanks have names. Mine do!
Anybody else smell that? That's hope, y'all!
I'd sure love a nice glass of sweet tea right about now.
Everybody's got good in 'em. Even you, Mr. Big Cannon.
tech: A magic glowin' cube! Don't that beat all! I bet it's just lonesome!
Whoa nelly, that's the shiniest thing I ever saw! I love it already!
Folks that give gifts can't be all bad, right? Right?
Maybe the Chorus just wants a friend! I'll take 'em some cookies!
I reckon technology's just friendship with extra steps!
joined: I'm so glad to be here, y'all! Is anyone hungry? I brought snacks!
Aw, thank you for believin' in me! I won't let ya down!
Well, I never! I'm gonna hug every last one of ya!
I'm all yours, partner! Let's go save the day!
Back with my friends where I belong! Yeehaw!
assimilated: Everything is wonderful. Please enjoy the unity.
I am so very happy. Aren't you happy, friend? Be happy.
There is no scrap. There is no struggle. There is only harmony.
Smile. Smile. Smile. It is all going to be fine.
Come closer, sweetheart. The Chorus has a place for you.
first_blood: Oh my stars, I got one! I'm real sorry, sugar, truly I am!
First one down! Bless his heart, he never saw it comin'.
Well shoot, that went and worked! Sorry 'bout that, friend.
One down! I hope his day gets better from here, I surely do.
first_loss: Oh no, we lost one! Y'all took a good one, but I forgive ya.
That one was a sweetheart. Y'all shoulda seen how he waved at me.
Aw, shucks. Chin up, folks, tomorrow's another day!
Well, that stings. But I reckon we'll be just fine.
hq_threat: Whoa now, y'all! That's my headquarters, and I'd really prefer you didn't!
Oh sugar, they're at the HQ! Everybody back home, quick as a rabbit!
Please step away from my headquarters! I'm askin' real nice!
I'm all for sharin', but not THAT building! Defend it, y'all!
building_lost: Aw, they took one of ours. I hope they take good care of it!
Well, I reckon they needed it more'n we did. Kiddin'! Get it back!
Oh dear, one of our buildings is gone. We'll make a new one. With cookies.
That was a lovely little building! Rest easy, sweet thing.
outnumbered: Well, there sure are a lot of 'em! More friends for us, I reckon!
They've got us outnumbered, but y'all know I love an underdog story.
Lordy, lookit all of 'em! I'd say hello to everybody, but there ain't time.
Odds are rough, but optimism never hurt nobody!
dominant: Why, we're doin' real well! Let's be gracious, y'all.
I do hope they ain't gettin' discouraged. Just a little more, then we're done!
Look at us go! Remember to be kind in victory, friends.
We've got 'em beat! Y'all want some lemonade after?
killing_spree: Oh my, that's a few now! I do apologise to each and every one of 'em.
Another one! I'm gonna write 'em all a nice letter.
I'm real sorry, but y'all keep walkin' into it!
That's a good day's work! I surely hope they get well soon.
heavy_losses: We're losin' so many, y'all! But we're still smilin', right? Right?
This is gettin' hard. But I believe in us. I truly do.
Oh, my heart! So many good folks gone. Hold together, y'all!
I've counted a few too many empty chairs. Time to turn it around!
first_turn: Alrighty, y'all, let's have us a good day and a clean fight!
Time to move! Saddle up, sweet things!
Mornin', everyone! Smile big, move quick.
Here we go! Remember to say please and thank you!
